style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted:
Introducing our 180cm Rustic Eucalyptus Garland, a stunning addition to your home decor. This garland features a beautiful blend of rustic green tonal foliage, including eucalyptus leaves and berries, creating an earthy ambiance in any space.

Crafted with attention to detail, this garland is perfect for adorning mantels, staircases, or even as a centerpiece on your dining table. The eucalyptus leaves and berries add a touch of elegance and charm.

Not only does this garland make a statement on its own, but it also pairs perfectly with our matching wreath, swag, candle holder, and arrangement in vase. Create a cohesive and coordinated look throughout your home by incorporating these complementary pieces.

Whether you're hosting a special occasion or simply want to add a touch of rustic charm to your everyday decor, our 180cm Rustic Eucalyptus Garland is the perfect choice. Its versatile design allows you to use it year-round, effortlessly transforming any space into a cozy and inviting haven. Bring beauty into your home with this exquisite garland.

• Length: 180cm
• Size: ONE
• Sheltered outdoor use only, bring indoors in extreme weather.
